endpoint_eligibility.allelic_direction_accuracy: ineligible because ABC has no REF-versus-ALT sequence term
endpoint_eligibility.eqtl_retrieval_auprc: eligible as a continuous unsigned link baseline after variant-to-element overlap is frozen
endpoint_eligibility.mean_fisher_z_celltype_spearman: ineligible standalone; any signed result is a separately registered composite
endpoint_eligibility.typed_evidence_graph: eligible as a typed unsigned link source, but the current task has no sealed source and therefore no champion

gse281364.allowed_use: Development-only overlap and orthogonal reporter-activity diagnostic. MPRA measures an isolated reporter construct and is not endogenous enhancer-gene link truth. No ABC lane, threshold, candidate-region definition, or contact choice may be selected on these outcomes.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time mapping of sealed variant positions onto a precommitted development-built cell-state link atlas. No sealed ATAC exists, and no eQTL/ieQTL outcome may alter peaks, normalization, gene roster, link scores, thresholds, or calibration.

gse296875.allowed_use: Build and evaluate donor-held cell-state ATAC link maps. Every candidate peak, signal track, quantile transform, gene filter, QC threshold, and pooled profile must be generated from outer-training donors for development scores.

reference_and_topology_contract.annotation: Generate a versioned GENCODE v49 TSS and gene table. Never silently use the upstream collapsed hg38 gene authority or map unmatched genes to zero.
reference_and_topology_contract.gse281364: Same-sample different-aliquot DNA and RNA counts do not establish endogenous enhancer-gene pairing.
reference_and_topology_contract.gse289173: RNA and QTL summaries are same-study unpaired. ABC consumes neither at native inference and produces no donor-specific score.
reference_and_topology_contract.gse296875: Same-nucleus identity is preserved in provenance but ABC uses donor-by-cell-state ATAC pseudobulk. Nuclei and fragments are not biological replicates.
reference_and_topology_contract.missingness: No ATAC, contact, gene mapping, or QC failure is encoded as zero. A structurally missing lane or row is not scored.

split_and_leakage_rules.candidate_regions: Call and rank peaks inside each outer-training donor partition. Held donors cannot affect the peak universe, qnorm, candidate cap, promoter definition, or gene-expression filter.
split_and_leakage_rules.donors: All nuclei and wells from one GSE296875 donor remain in one outer fold; retain well as a technical batch and donor as the inferential unit.
split_and_leakage_rules.genomics: Cross donor folds with native-build merged LD/locus blocks. Variants in one merged block remain together, and region or gene neighborhoods cannot cross into a held block through score denominators.
split_and_leakage_rules.sealed_atlas: After model selection, rebuild the named static link atlas from all admitted development donors, hash it, and lock it before anonymized sealed variant features are opened.
split_and_leakage_rules.variant_overlap: Use a project evaluator with exact coordinates and continuous scores. The upstream hard-coded variant-overlap helper is forbidden.
